info.title: meshy/relief
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "meshy/relief", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: Request body for Meshy's relief operation (docs.meshy.ai/en/api/relief): turn one image into a printable relief model and a depth map. The same schema serves the v1 /proxy route and the Comfy Router route, and the body is forwarded unchanged. Relief tasks cannot be the input of other Meshy operations.

base_thickness_mm.description: Base plate thickness in millimeters, 0.1 to 10. With remove_base true, omit it or send 0.

bend_angle.description: Bend angle in degrees. Below 1 the relief stays flat.

bend_axis.description: `xz` (default, bends the left and right edges) or `yz` (bends the top and bottom edges). Applies only when bend_mode is convex or concave.

carving_depth_mm.description: Carving depth in millimeters. The default is 6 for variant high and 3 for variant low.

color_mapping.description: Color the model from the image. GLB, OBJ, FBX and USDZ carry the color; STL and 3MF stay white. The cost does not change.

image_url.description: A public URL or data URI of a jpg, jpeg, png or webp image. At most 20 MB and at least 32 x 32 pixels. Transparent areas are filled with black.

mesh_resolution.description: Points along the longer side. Larger values give much larger files (about 150 MB GLB and 300 MB STL at 2048).

removal_threshold.description: Background removal threshold. Applies only when remove_base is true.

remove_base.description: Cut away the background so the relief has no base plate.

should_generate_model.description: Set to false for a depth map only, with no model and no preview. The cost does not change.

size_mm.description: Length of the longer side in millimeters.

target_formats.description: The model formats to generate. One or more of glb, obj, fbx, stl, usdz and 3mf. The default is glb and stl.

variant.description: `low` (default) gives slight depth and finer detail, for laser or CNC work. `high` gives deeper, sculptural relief, for 3D printing. It also sets the default carving_depth_mm.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description:
Comfy Router output schema for Meshy's relief operation: the terminal `GET /proxy/meshy/openapi/v1/relief/{task_id}` task document, forwarded unchanged. The operation is SUBMIT-AND-POLL. `POST /proxy/meshy/openapi/v1/relief` answers a `MeshyReliefCreateResponse` handle whose `result` is the task id, and Router polls on the caller's behalf, so the body a caller receives is the finished task document.
`meshy/relief` names an OPERATION, not a model version. It turns one image into a printable relief. The model is in `model_urls`, one URL per requested format (GLB in meters, STL in millimeters by default). The 2k 16-bit depth map is in `depth_map_url`. A task with `should_generate_model: false` has an empty `model_urls` and only the depth map. The files are large (about 50 MB GLB and 105 MB STL at the default `mesh_resolution`, much more at 2048), so download them from Meshy's URLs.
`status` is Meshy's own UPPERCASE vocabulary. `SUCCEEDED` is the one terminal success. `FAILED` reaches a Router caller as a Comfy Router error with Meshy's reason in `task_error.message`.

MeshyReliefModelUrls.description: Downloadable URLs to the relief model files, one per requested format. Empty for a depth-map-only task.

fbx.description: Downloadable URL to the FBX file.

glb.description: Downloadable URL to the GLB file, in meters.

mtl.description: Downloadable URL to the MTL material file for the OBJ file.

obj.description: Downloadable URL to the OBJ file.

stl.description: Downloadable URL to the binary STL file, in millimeters.

usdz.description: Downloadable URL to the USDZ file.

consumed_credits.description: Meshy credits the task used. 0 for a failed task.

created_at.description: Timestamp of when the task was created, in milliseconds.

depth_map_url.description: Downloadable URL to the 2k 16-bit grayscale depth map PNG. The values are relative, not millimeters.

expires_at.description: Timestamp of when the task result expires, in milliseconds. 0 if not finished.

finished_at.description: Timestamp of when the task was finished, in milliseconds. 0 if not finished.

preceding_tasks.description: The count of preceding tasks. Only meaningful when status is PENDING.

progress.description: Progress of the task. 0 if not started, 100 when succeeded.

started_at.description: Timestamp of when the task was started, in milliseconds. 0 if not started.

texture_urls.description: Texture URLs. Present only with color_mapping true.

thumbnail_url.description: Downloadable URL to the preview image. Empty for a depth-map-only task.

type.description: Type of the task. Always relief.

MeshyTaskError.description: Error object that contains the error message if the task failed.

MeshyTextureUrls.description: Texture URL object containing PBR maps.

base_color.description: Downloadable URL to the base color map image.

metallic.description: Downloadable URL to the metallic map image.

normal.description: Downloadable URL to the normal map image.

roughness.description: Downloadable URL to the roughness map image.
